"Evergreen"Joe Wilson popped up yet again to win the Club Handicap from Will Belderson with Bob Barnes third. Our thanks are due to the officials judges and helpers who once again on a cold day enabled us to hold another Championship.
Shortly afterwards Bob Barnes lost a few places but finished our first man home in 9th place followed by the ever-improving Will Belderson, 14th in 84:13.
Also in close attendance were Will Belderson and Ken Bailey with Gerry Cameron again giving us a pleasant surprise by finishing first of the 'B' team in 23rd place.
Will Belderson was awarded the Sir J.Coleman Cup. Unfortunately, George Williams was affected by the cold, never appeared to settle down and was disqualified in the first mile.
Will Belderson recorded his best time ever (58:00) to finish 11th whilst Don Bartliff finished 20th in 59:05 and gained his 7 mile star for the first time.

Don Bartliff had taken over fourth team position for us, and confirmed that he has all the promise of championships to come in the years ahead; well backed by Ken Bailey, George Beecham, and Will Belderson.
Shields were 16th and 18th in the '5', R. Middleton and W.
